A MoveTo Curve is a special curve type consisting of a single point. Unlike other curve types,
it does not draw anything — it simply repositions the current endpoint of a `Path`, analogous
to the SVG `moveto` command. Use it within a `Phaser.Curves.Path` to create a gap between
two sub-paths, or to begin drawing from a new position without connecting to the previous curve.

m.x: A flag indicating that this curve is inactive and does not contribute to the bounds, length, or rendering of its parent Path. It is always `false` for a MoveTo, which marks it as a positional marker rather than a drawable segment.
The lone point which this curve consists of.
Gets the length of this curve.

r.x: The length of this curve. For a MoveTo the value is always 0.

m.x: Returns the single point that this MoveTo curve represents. Because a MoveTo has only one point, the value of `t` is ignored and `p0` is always returned.

p.x: The position along the curve to return. Where 0 is the start and 1 is the end.
A Vector2 object to store the result in. If not given will be created.

r.x: The coordinates of the point on the curve. If an `out` object was given this will be returned.

m.x: Retrieves the point at given position in the curve. This will always return this curve's only point.

p.x: The position in the path to retrieve, between 0 and 1. Not used.
An optional vector in which to store the point.

r.x: The modified `out` vector, or a new `Vector2` if none was provided.

m.x: Gets the resolution of this curve.

r.x: The resolution of this curve. For a MoveTo the value is always 1.

m.x: Converts this curve into a JSON-serializable object.

r.x: A primitive object with the curve's type and only point.
